name: bahnpilot
description: Bahnpilot — Open Source Bahn Navigator mit Echtzeit | PWA + Android APK
author: Bahnpilot Contributors

scripts.sync:www: mkdir -p www && cp index.html www/ && cp manifest.json www/ && cp -r icons www/ && cp sw.js www/ && echo 'www synced'
scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:copy: npm run sync:www && npx cap copy android
scripts.build:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:apk:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
